text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down the hallway—
I heard Gran Alegria's voice!
Save me, Chrono-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan...!?
W-What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Today's dance just doesn't feel right!
Ugh, I feel so frustrated! Like, 30 miles worth of frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so?
Her footwork looked flawless to me, as always.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I can do the movements.
But, like, you know, it needs more of that... whoosh...
choice_data_list: You can dance it, but it just feels like something's missing?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Ah, yes! Just like that!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"It feels, you know, a bit different
from dancing on stage during a concert."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The difference from... a concert, you say?
I'm not sure if this will serve as a hint, but—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In the past, a famous Umamusume left behind
the maxim: "Races are individual, concerts are a collective."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "These words preach that individual ability is crucial for racing, while working together as one is what matters for Lives—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, I get it! Got it!
Thanks, Chrono-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah... Huh...?! Y-Yes?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Dancing is so much happier with a practice partner!
That's what joining forces is all about, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Phew, all refreshed♪
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My practice partner for today is officially Chrono-chan!
Nice to be working with you!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, well... I suppose it would turn out that way.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-hmmm~♪ What kind of practice should we do~?
choice_data_list: Match your breath and step together!
Sing while you dance, create that harmony!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Taking steps together...
Indeed, that is certainly something one could never do alone.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: W-Well then. I shall join you...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
One-two, three-four!
One-two, three-four!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
This is it!! I can practically hear the massive cheers!!
Sparkle meter at 120 miles per hour!!
choice_data_list: You're shining even brighter than before!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I was able to help out.
Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Harmonizing our voices together...
Indeed, that is certainly something one could never do alone.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: W-Well then. I shall join you...

text_block_list.name: Gran & Chrono
text_block_list.text: "*Ba-thump, ba-thump, taking off at a sprint—!*"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, this is it☆
It's 100 miles of charm... no, 120 miles!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Chrono-chan!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Not at all, if I was able to help... Hehehe!
